zh.title: 房屋 Inspection 指南
zh.seo_title: 房屋 Inspection 指南｜陈靖
zh.description: 买房要做哪些检查？本文说明综合检查、白蚁、屋顶、地基、电气、下水等项目，如何在 Contingency 期内安排，加州 inspector 无专门执照的现实，以及 2026 年电气声明新规和常见误区。
zh.lead: Inspection 让你看到卖方可能不知道的事。接受 offer 后尽早安排，并在期限内作出决定。

en.title: A Buyer's Guide to Home Inspections
en.seo_title: Buyer's Guide to Home Inspections | Jing Chen
en.description: Which inspections to order, how to run them inside the contingency period, what California law says about inspectors, and common mistakes to avoid.
en.lead: An inspection shows what the seller may not know. Book it right after acceptance and decide before the deadline.
